body: macOS M1 to M3 results (probe profile build at d36b748, in-app input only, guard armed):U+000AU+000AU+002D M1 navigation: pass. Today, Calendar, Garden, Search and Settings render with no errors; calendar Left/Right and T work; Escape closes the month picker; the window clamps at 873x600 and lays out cleanly there and at 1800x1086. Escape on Settings does nothing (the sidebar is always visible, so not recorded as a defect). Evidence m1_*.png.U+000AU+002D M2 write a note: pass. `# ` heading, Cmd+B bold, Cmd+K on a selected word wraps it as `[lighthouse]()` with the caret in the URL, `- ` list, Cmd+Shift+9 task. Card shows styling with no Markdown symbols; reopen gives the identical source. Hovering a card reveals Edit and Delete at its top right; clicking the body opens the viewer. Evidence m2_*.png.U+000AU+002D M3 photos: pass with one cosmetic defect. Add memory inserts a photo floated right at medium; typing a letter with the photo selected puts it on a new line after the photo and keeps the photo (Android B3 has no macOS counterpart). JPEG clipboard paste inserts a photo. Removing the second photo in edit and saving persists ("1 photo"). Cosmetic: removal leaves an empty paragraph where the photo was (`Anemones everywhere.\n\nHome before the rain.`), visible as an extra blank line in the viewer (m3_after_remove.png).U+000AU+002D M5 draft safety (partial, unplanned): the guard aborted and killed the probe mid-note after an owner keypress at 00:41:32; reopening Write a note showed "Draft restored" with the exact text and photo (m5_draft_restored.png).U+000AU+002D c5 finding 2 (file-URL-only paste inserts nothing): NOT REPRODUCED. The harness helper `tool/probe/macos/pasteboard.swift files` calls writeObjects([NSURL]) and, on macOS 26.5.1, leaves the general pasteboard with zero items (changeCount bumps, no types), so the 2026-09-24 result tested an empty clipboard. With a real `public.file-url` item written via NSPasteboardItem (verified by listing types and AppleScript `the clipboard as «class furl»`), Cmd+V inserted the photo (m3_paste_fileurl_real.png). This is a harness bug in pasteboard.swift, not an app defect. A real Finder Cmd+C copy is still an owner hand check.U+000AU+002D Owner took control once (keypress, 00:41:32); the guard aborted within 0.1 s. A new probe instance (pid 60935) was open afterwards; testing resumed only after 20 s of owner idle.
